subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Astronaut"** means a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft. (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)

 
 
• **Example: **Neil Armstrong was the first astronaut to walk on the moon.
 
 
 
• **"Astronaut" **refers to someone who has been trained and certified to travel and work in space, particularly on spacecraft missions. (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)
 
 
• **Example: **Many astronauts undergo extensive training before their missions to space.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anthropologist **(मानवविज्ञानी): A person who studies human societies, cultures, and their development.

 
 
• **Example:** The anthropologist spent years living with the indigenous tribe to understand their customs and rituals.
 
 
 
• **Alchemist **(रसविद्या): A person who practices alchemy, the medieval precursor to chemistry, focused on transforming matter.
 
 
• **Example: **The alchemist was believed to have the ability to turn base metals into gold.
 
 
 
• **Curator** (संग्रहालयाध्यक्ष): A person responsible for the care and management of a museum's collection.
 
 
• **Example:** The curator organized a new exhibition showcasing ancient artifacts.
